advisory.summary: code injection / OS command execution: the SQL Expressions feature reaches runDuckQuery, which executes attacker-controlled SQL through the DuckDB engine binary (DuckDB file functions enable LFI/RCE); the upstream fix removes the go-duck dependency and the exec sink outright

acquisition.notes: Stdlib-only reduced repro of Grafana CVE-2024-9264 (SQL Expressions to DuckDB RCE/LFI) at the parent of the fix commit (cbe1e7d63f098e306058c0fbcab2f5c30602fa7d). The /api/ds/query http_route handler forwards the attacker-controlled sql parameter straight into the first-party sink runDuckQuery, which execs the DuckDB engine binary. Reduced to a single package-main file so the pure-Go call graph connects ingress to sink hermetically; the advisory names main.runDuckQuery as a first-party sink govulncheck never traces.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The /api/ds/query ingress reaches main.runDuckQuery, which passes attacker-controlled SQL to exec.Command('duckdb', ...) -- SQL injection plus DuckDB file functions yield LFI/RCE (CWE-94/CWE-78), so the first-party ingress-to-sink taint path is statically complete and reachable. Confirming command execution requires a live detonation the current sandbox capability does not exercise here, so analysis stops at reachable-but-unconfirmed (stopped_capability); reasoned, not proven. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
